question.text: In the context of a tender offer buyback, within how many days of the Public Announcement must the draft Letter of Offer be filed through a non-associated merchant banker?

explanation.text: The Logic: For a tender offer buyback, the draft Letter of Offer must be filed within five days of the Public Announcement, and the filing must be made through a merchant banker who is not associated with the company (NISM-Series-IX workbook, p.222). The Trap: The 2-day option points toward other tender-offer timelines (such as the 2-working-day final LOF filing from the record date on p.225); the p.222 draft-LOF rule itself uses the "within five days" wording. Note: Read the draft-LOF five-day rule and the non-associated merchant banker requirement directly from p.222.
